profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Applied Vision Corporation
profile.summary:
I am a passionate, self-motivated, and innovative problem solver specializing in computer vision, image processing, full stack web development, and automated software testing.

I have lead small and large software projects, while being heavily involved with their development.  I am a quick learner and effective teacher, assisting the team adapt new technologies. I'm personable, work well with others, and strive to help however possible.

My ability to efficiently adapt to market demands, and assume multiple responsibilities allow me to be an effective contributor to any project.

Other Activities:
   - Eagle Scout, Boy Scouts of America
   - Website Development (React/Next), Computer Game development (Unity), 
   - PCB design (DesignSpark), Microcontrollers (Arduino)
   - Swim Team, Tennis Team, Choir at Firestone High School
   - Guitar, Gardening, Outdoor enthusiast, hiking, biking, camping, fishing, ect.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
2023 - Now
Lead software developer on an agile team. Converting our MFC app, to a modern web app, using Vue, ASP.Net, PostgreSQL, Module federation (micro frontend/services), and Consul. Also lead test developer, teaching the team Xunit, Google test, Vitest, Cypress and Ranorex. Then, automating those tests and code coverage report in a CI pipeline, on Azure devops.

2022 - 2023
Managed the design, implementation, and testing to expand an existing system's vision capabilities and share data with customer's system. Responsible for customer correspondence, running design meetings, writing code, and setting/delivering milestones. A patent that includes my name was submitted in spring 2024.

2021
Managed the design, implementation, and testing of a new vision system product, using IR cameras to find defects. Responsible for customer correspondence, running design meetings, writing code, and setting/delivering milestones.

2017 - 2020
Software developer on an agile team. Computer app development (MFC and Qt), database development (postgres), and computer vision development (openCV). Responsible for writing, maintaining, documenting and testing C++ and C# code.

positions.title: Co-op Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Diebold’s firmware development team to write firmware for company modules. Worked on their 
automated testing software, developing test cases for new functions using C#. Also developed a few 		Splunk searches to record and analyze problems in the field.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Agile Methodologies · Software Development · Test Automation

positions.title: Co-op Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Diebold’s software development team to improve efficiency and automate testing. During this assignment, wrote an automation script, using Autoit,  used to  gather and upload log files. Experience gained in design collaboration and software development.  Workload was 40 hours per week.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Agile Methodologies · Software Development · Test Automation

positions.title: Co-Op System Integration Testing
positions.description: System integration tester under the Software Quality Assurance department. Participated in teamwork testing software and hardware on various ATM models. As a side project, I wrote a VBA code to better view and analyze the budget report. Experienced gained in team problem solving, project communication and people management.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Software Development · Test Automation

positions.description:
Responsible for the safety of occupants in and around pool area, manage residence participation
and guest passes, clean surrounding area, maintain pool, and landscape several gardens outside
pool area. Experience gained working with the general public and safety measures along with
maintenance responsibilities. Workload was 25 hours per week.
